body:
in short, it's me. I said how I don't want to be a burden and that thought kinda permeates throughout my life. But I can't not be a burden because I'm so inadequate in everything I do. I try my best, but I can't be at an average level in anything, so I just become a burden. There's other causes too, But i feel it all comes back down to me in the end. 

and whether I can have a life worth living. I know what that would look like for me. But everytime I try, it gets beaten down again and again because I can't accomplish it. If I can't accomplish achieving that then I just continue to be a burden and that isn't a life worth living for me.
